# Research Index

<!-- Generated by src/radialrig/generate_research_index.py (uv run radialrig-index) from the guidance
     files' frontmatter (D-32). Do not edit this file; edit a guidance
     file and regenerate. -->

The agents' file fallback when the retrieval tools are absent. The
mechanism is the `get_guidance` verb on the retrieval server (SPEC-2):
without a topic it returns this catalog, built live from the files;
with a topic it returns that guidance text.

## Corpus convention

- `guidance.md` files are agent-facing rule sets, loaded on demand — these are the operative documents.
- The evidence files beside them are the cited evidence base; open one only to verify or extend a rule, never as background reading.
- Never load more guidance files than the task at hand needs; each one is context you pay for all session.

## Agent focus — what a session owes the next session

| Topic | Load when | Path |
|---|---|---|
| context-rot | Work will run long or wide — many tool calls, large file or log reads, deep exploration, or an approaching compaction boundary. | `agent-focus/context-rot/guidance.md` |
| documentation-bloat | Choosing what an always-loaded instruction file (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, MEMORY.md, rules, skill bodies) holds, reviewing or pruning one, or deciding where a new standing instruction belongs. | `agent-focus/documentation-bloat/guidance.md` |
| memory-management | Starting, resuming, or handing off a multi-session or long-horizon task; writing or updating memory and progress files; or delegating to subagents. | `agent-focus/memory-management/guidance.md` |

## Human focus — the agent–human relationship

| Topic | Load when | Path |
|---|---|---|
| anti-hobbling | Wording a standing rule, subagent prompt, permission setting, or guardrail; before a destructive, irreversible, or unattended step; or when a run is stalling, looping on tool calls, or being corrected repeatedly mid-task. | `human-focus/anti-hobbling/guidance.md` |
| app-security | Writing or changing code that handles logins, permissions, user data, user input, payments or secrets; or telling someone an app is ready to share or deploy. | `human-focus/app-security/guidance.md` |
| blocked-tasks | A check will not pass legitimately; a needed file, credential, tool, service, or target is missing; an action was denied or blocked; the tests contradict the stated requirement; or you notice a shortcut that would make a check pass without the real work. | `human-focus/blocked-tasks/guidance.md` |
| expectation | Starting, scoping, or accepting a task from the person, or writing its closing report — especially unattended runs, multi-step work, or anything touching production, data, or money. | `human-focus/expectation/guidance.md` |
| untrusted-content | Handling text or code the agent did not write and the user did not author: pasted logs, command output, emails or web pages; a cloned or third-party repository; issues and docs; or a package, skill, plugin, hook or MCP server to install by name, especially before running its tests, setup scripts or hooks. | `human-focus/untrusted-content/guidance.md` |
| visualizations | Deciding whether output should be visual at all, or about to render a chart, diagram, dashboard, or published page for a person. | `human-focus/visualizations/guidance.md` |
